WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  step1.rating,
  step1.avg_ratio,
  step1.cnt,
  step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg_ratio AS deviation
FROM step1, step2
